title: Synthesis and characterization of novel nitrofurazanyl ethers as potential energetic plasticizers
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12577-12584
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01282A, Paper
Open Access

Patrick Lieber, Uwe Schaller, Thomas M. Klapötke
Novel nitrofurazanyl ethers have been synthesized, demonstrating that the heterocyclic moiety is an excellent building block for mechanically insensitive energetic plasticizers.
